findings.description: `minutes()` rounds a backlog just past the budget down to the budget. A backlog in (60, 60.05) prints as "The merge lock's backlog is 60.0 minutes, over the project's budget of 60" in the refusal, and as "60.0 of 60 minutes" next to `Launch: refused (merge-lock backlog over budget)` in `pup status`. Gate times are whole milliseconds, so for example 8 uses at a median between 450,001 and 450,374 ms land in that range. Round up (e.g. `(Math.ceil(value * 10) / 10).toFixed(1)`) so a refused value always prints above the budget.

Three comments still refer to the session cap this PR removed: usage-limits.service.ts:85 explains its link and fifo safety as 'as `maxSessions` reads its file', a function that no longer exists; session-runtime.service.ts:1139 places the conductor's pid file 'beside its session cap', a file no longer written; capability.utils.ts:9 still lists 'the session cap under the store'. A reader following any of them finds nothing.
